## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Most High Língbǎo Pure-Illumination Dòngshén Superior-Grade Scripture*

Anonymous; Sòng-Yuán

The opening scripture of the ***Jìng míng*** 淨明 ("Pure Illumination") revelation-corpus within the Dào zàng — texts of the **Jìng míng zhōng xiào dào** 淨明忠孝道 ("Way of Pure Illumination, Loyalty, and Filiality"), a Daoist movement centered on the cult of [許遜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A8%B1%E9%81%9C) Xǔ Xùn at Xī shān 西山 (Jiāngxī), attaining its mature form in the 12th–14th centuries. Preserved as **DZ 1103** / CT 1103 (Tài píng bù 太平部).

**Dating.** Sòng-Yuán. Dynasty: 宋-元.
